description: REFERENCE (rom_signature + segments) for Pokemon Emerald (USA BPEE). ExcelAddr covers ONLY the USA version (BPEE); other Emerald versions live in gba_pokemon.py FIXED_TABLES with version-specific addresses. Covered: the four fixed-width name tables from FIXED_TABLES['emerald']: names 0x3185C8 (11x412), attacks 0x31977C (13x355), types 0x31AE38 (7x18), abilities 0x31B6DB (13x78) - all verified against a real ROM. Full extraction (all dialogs, pointer tables) is NOT covered by this JSON; use the gba_pokemon.py plugin for complete coverage. String terminators (0xFF) are handled by the decoder (0x00/0xFF/0xFE decode as line breaks). Hack authors: copy and adapt title_pattern to match YOUR hack ROM title.
